question: Which teams have earned their record, and which are living on close games?

headline.text: Washington Mystics sit about 3.5 wins ahead of what their play supports and are 11-5 in games decided by 5 or fewer; Seattle Storm sit 6.6 wins behind theirs at 0-13.

body: The standings tell you who has won. They are quieter about who has earned it. So we re-graded every team's season against the schedule it actually faced - opponent strength, venue, and rest, game by game - and asked a simple question: given all that, how many wins did this team deserve?
Three answers jump off the table.

Washington Mystics' record is the league's biggest mirage: about 3.5 wins better than its play supports, and its hold on a playoff place leans on exactly those wins. Eleven of the Mystics' victories came in games decided by five points or fewer - coin flips landing heads at a 69 percent clip.

Seattle is the most undersold team in basketball. The Storm have played like a team roughly 6.6 wins better than their record - the largest gap we measure in either direction - and they are 0-13 in close games, roughly a one-in-8,192 run. It will not save their season. But if you are evaluating Seattle players, their coach, or them as a September opponent, grade them by the margins.
And Atlanta carries a warning label: a deserved record already trailing the actual one, at 23.2 earned wins against 24 real ones. They earned their wins; the slate ahead is the problem.

Which brings us to the 2 days that will sort out the middle of the bracket. Four teams sit within three wins of each other for the next four seeds, and three head-to-head games remain among them. Atlanta plays in TWO - all between September 21 and September 23. Atlanta at New York. Atlanta at New York. 2 days, every rival, a tired schedule. The Dream will not sneak into their seed. They will have to take it.

A footnote for the calendar. Indiana, with just one head-to-head games left, has the least control of the four - but the softest surrounding schedule, which is why the odds still like them most. Control and comfort are different assets. August will tell us which one this race rewards.
Atlanta also visits New York twice in three days in late September, on September 21 and September 23.
Every number above updates nightly, and every projection built on them gets graded in public the next morning. That is the deal here.
